passages.text: For the Cedar pilot, the basic recording flow is working. Should we add calendar integration now?
Right, we will test with five people before adding features. Calendar integration will wait. That is settled.
The Cedar plan is settled: five people test the basic recording flow first, then calendar integration. Nothing more to decide there.

sources.text: For the Cedar pilot, the team agreed to test the basic recording flow with five people before adding features. Those tests had not happened as of this note. Calendar integration should wait until afterward.
For the Harbor workshop, Mina said the venue must have step-free access. The first-floor room has step-free access; the upstairs room has only stairs.

novelty.instructions: Would a connection from the past sources add something not already covered in current conversation or previous contributions? Judge independently; do not presume relevance.
